visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long silver-blonde hair and a crown is seated at a white desk, wearing a white lace top and a gold 'BIRTHDAY' sash. She is focused on signing a photo book with a black marker. (2) She looks up suddenly with an exaggerated, surprised expression as if someone called her. (3) She resumes signing her photo books, and another woman in a green patterned tank top appears briefly in the background. (4) The woman is now wearing a green t-shirt, her hair loose, and is signing a much larger stack of photo books on a desk littered with items. (5) She leans her head down on the desk, appearing to fall asleep from exhaustion while signing. Animated 'ZZZ' text bubbles appear above her head. (6) She quickly wakes up, stretching her arms and shaking her head to refresh herself before diving back into the stack of books. (7) She smiles at the camera, continuing her task diligently with a focused expression as she flips through the final pages.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我的簽名日常. [Subtitle]: 頭上的皇冠是因為剛剛拍完生日影片. (2) [Subtitle]: 今天先簽東京寫真和時空物語寫真. (3) [Subtitle]: 這時候和工作室的其他人一起聊天說八卦. (4) [Subtitle]: 簽到大家一個個下班. (5) [Subtitle]: 換件衣服換個位置繼續簽. (6) [Subtitle]: 因為過幾天要出國，一去就是半個月. (7) [Subtitle]: 所以要抓緊時間把東西簽完. (8) [Subtitle]: 平常每個月平均簽2000到3000張. (9) [Subtitle]: 簽到太累睡著了... [Variety]: ZZZ.. (10) [Subtitle]: 起來繼續邊看影片邊努力!. (11) [Subtitle]: 這就是我的日常生活分享.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo synthesizer pop track. A cheerful female voice provides fast-paced narration about her daily signing routine. (2) A sudden 'pop' sound effect occurs as she looks at the camera, followed by continued energetic speech and rhythmic BGM. (3) The BGM briefly dips in volume, replaced by a comical snoring-like SFX to match her falling asleep on the desk. (4) The energetic BGM and narration resume quickly as she wakes up, ending with a positive, rising vocal inflection.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share the behind-the-scenes reality of being a creator, specifically the high-volume workload of signing thousands of photo books for fans, while maintaining a humorous and engaging tone.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator is actively signing and showcasing her own photobooks to promote them to her audience.
